lines.en: I drift along with my toes off the ground.
The airflow sweeps my blonde hair back.

lines.zh: 不用迈步，我照样到得快
lines.en: No need to stride; I still arrive fast.

lines.zh: 我悬浮在一人高的位置
lines.en: I hover at head height.
No footfalls, only wind.
I slip sideways past the treetops.
My blue eyes stay fixed ahead.

lines.zh: 这点距离，飞着就过去了
lines.en: This distance is nothing while flying.

lines.zh: 我抬手拨开挡路的气流
lines.en: I brush the airflow out of my way.
My jacket's hem trails behind me.
I can't be bothered to walk, so I float.
My body feels weightless.
Arms folded, I wait for you to move.
My energy never runs low.
My hair's mussed; I smooth it back.

lines.zh: 这地方连个像样的对手都没有
lines.en: Not one decent opponent here.
I squint up at the sky.
An android's body doesn't tire.
One roll of the wrist — warmed up.

lines.zh: 风把我的夹克吹得鼓起来
lines.en: The wind billows my jacket.
I've nothing much to say.
I stand on air, perfectly steady.
I glance down at the ground.
Silence is less trouble than talk.
I tuck my hands back in my pockets.
Patience is something I have plenty of.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，没什么兴趣
lines.en: I look up at you, unimpressed.
There's a trace of ki on you.
You? Standing in front of me?

lines.zh: 我的视线扫过你的手脚
lines.en: My gaze sweeps over your hands and feet.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我还没打算动手
lines.en: Relax. I'm not moving yet.
Your stance is one big opening.
I know that look. You want a fight.
My blue eyes meet yours.
You're holding your ki far too tight.
I tilt my head, waiting for you to speak.
Are you done staring at me?
I don't smile, and I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 你的心跳我听得很清楚
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat quite clearly.
Interesting. You're not backing off.
Fine. I'll remember you.
My expression hasn't changed.
You're sizing me up; so am I.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬下巴，算是回应
lines.en: I lift my chin by way of answer.
I turn my body and shed most of the force.
That one grazed me.
I give half a block, then reset my stance.
Barely any blood. You'd hardly notice.
Your fist is heavier than I thought.
I frown once. Just once.

lines.zh: 护甲挡了一层，剩下我扛
lines.en: The armour took one layer; I take the rest.
It hurts, but it doesn't slow my strikes.
You finally touched me.
Then I should return the favour.
You'd bait me with that? Childish.
Food doesn't matter to me.

lines.zh: 人造人不靠这些东西活着
lines.en: Androids don't live on such things.

lines.zh: 我倒是想知道你想干什么
lines.en: I'd rather know what you're after.
Hold it up much longer and your arm will ache.

lines.zh: 你把它当诱饵，太明显了
lines.en: As bait, it's painfully obvious.
I come closer only to see you clearly.
Don't back off; I'm not here to snatch it.
Keep it for yourself.
I float a little lower. That's all.
You hit me like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你自己弹开
lines.en: I don't budge; you bounce off.
Don't crowd me. I dislike it.
My shoulder is harder than yours.
The airflow scatters, then closes again.
I brush you aside with one hand.
Half a step back and we can still talk.

lines.zh: 撞我不算本事，站稳才算
lines.en: Hitting me proves nothing; standing does.
Your footing slipped.
I'll keep that in mind.
I don't need anyone guarding me.
Keep up with my speed first.
Flying side by side wouldn't be bad.
Don't expect me to turn gentle.

lines.zh: 你的气很稳，这点我喜欢
lines.en: Your ki is steady. I like that.
I fly faster. Don't fall behind.

lines.zh: 真到了那天，我不会多说
lines.en: If that day comes, I won't say much.
Give me your hand. Just this once.
The wind's strong. Come closer.

lines.zh: 我们都不是会回头的人
lines.en: Neither of us looks back.
I bend down and pick it up to look.
This thing on the ground is curious.
I pinch it between two fingertips.

lines.zh: 不需要，但我不介意拿着
lines.en: I don't need it, but I'll hold it.
Yours? I'll hang on to it.
I toss it once and catch it.
It weighs almost nothing at all.
Some use in it. I'll keep it.
I drop it into my pocket.
Don't stare while I pick things up.

lines.zh: 你动了手，那就不客气了
lines.en: You struck first. No more courtesy.
My ki is already rising.
Locked on. Don't bother running.
You can't catch me in the air.
I've already counted out the combo.
Let's test your reflexes.
The Destructo Disc is no ornament.
I rise for a better view.
You can't even reach my sleeve.
I'm getting serious. Sure about this?
Ki is already in my palm.
Don't look up. Something's above you.
My speed alone will be enough.
From this moment, you're the target.
Let's see how many hits you take.
I count to three, then I come.
I circle you, in no hurry.
You raise a hand and I rise.
Your ki is starting to waver.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，封住你头顶
lines.en: I hang overhead, sealing off your sky.
Ki blasts are all about angle.
You guard left; the right is open.
I wait for one perfect moment.
Dodging is second nature to me.

lines.zh: 你的每一拳我都看得见
lines.en: I see every punch coming.

lines.zh: 我不用喘气，你有这个本事吗
lines.en: I don't need breath. Can you say that?
I cut off your retreat long ago.
A little closer, and I strike.
The light in my hand keeps brightening.
Don't panic. It won't help.

lines.zh: 我算准了你落地的位置
lines.en: I've worked out where you'll land.
A ki barrage will seal your path.

lines.zh: 你抬盾的样子有点可笑
lines.en: That shield-up stance is almost funny.
I'm not even at full strength.
One straight kick, dead centre.

lines.zh: 我的连击不给人喘的空
lines.en: My combo leaves no room to breathe.
My knife-hand falls and splits the air.

lines.zh: 气圆斩贴着你的肩膀过
lines.en: The disc skims past your shoulder.
I drive an elbow into your ribs.
A ki blast bursts at your feet.

lines.zh: 你挡住第一下，挡不住第三下
lines.en: You block the first, not the third.
I kick your weapon away.
This punch lands with just enough force.
You retreat; I follow.
I strike the seam in your armour.
The air is my advantage.
I spin once and my heel arrives.

lines.zh: 你连我的影子都追不上
lines.en: You can't even catch my shadow.
That one will stay with you a while.
When it's done, I'm still right here.
I descend without a sound.
My blonde hair stands out in the light.

lines.zh: 任务派我来的，不是巧合
lines.en: A mission sent me; this is no accident.
I come from above. Look up.
The ki in this place is thin.
I straighten my jacket's collar.
Android 18. Remember it.
I'm not here for money or for ki.
Someone needs dealing with.
I hover three blocks above you.

lines.zh: 来之前我连话都懒得想
lines.en: I didn't even plan what to say.
Don't take me for an ordinary enemy.
This world's gravity is so light.

lines.zh: 我提前到了，你晚了一步
lines.en: I arrived early. You're late.
Who's making trouble here?
Let's see if this is worth my effort.
I'll look, then leave. Don't expect me to stay.
The wind changed. I'm here.
Flame licks my jacket; I swat it out.

lines.zh: 我砸进地里，扬起一圈土
lines.en: I slam into the ground and dirt sprays out.
Water crushes my chest; I push upward.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我推出去几格
lines.en: The shockwave shoves me back a few blocks.

lines.zh: 箭穿进肩膀，我一把拔掉
lines.en: The arrow sinks into my shoulder; I yank it out.
That force went around my armour.

lines.zh: 身体在耗自己，我感觉得到
lines.en: My body is burning itself. I can feel it.
Current races wild through my body.

lines.zh: 下方什么都没有，我在坠落
lines.en: Nothing below me, and I'm falling.
